def solve(g):
 from collections import Counter
 cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
 # two most frequent are background colors; remaining rare nonzero marker
 bg={x for x,_ in cnt.most_common(2)}
 colors=set(cnt)-bg
 # marker color(s): the unique color beyond dominant two
 marker=next(iter(colors))
 pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
 r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
 c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
 mask=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
 H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1

# Write reusable task program.
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the marked shape onto every all-zero matching placement."""
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    backgrounds = {value for value, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    markers = set(counts) - backgrounds
    if not markers:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = next(iter(markers))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    min_r, max_r = min(r for r, _ in points), max(r for r, _ in points)
    min_c, max_c = min(c for _, c in points), max(c for _, c in points)
    mask = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    height, width = max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
